description:
Shipped documentation has drifted from the current CLI, storage layout, and repository structure, and jit self-documentation has leaked into the adopter-facing docs tree. This epic corrects verified drift and makes the boundary between adopter documentation (docs/) and jit's own contributor documentation (dev/, CLAUDE.md) explicit.

## Background

A source-verified audit (2026-07-06, findings document linked to this issue) confirmed 46 findings: stale paths and counts, wrong semantic claims about git requirements and storage locations, legacy narration in shipped references, an incomplete command reference, and self-documentation misplaced in the adopter tree. CLAUDE.md corrections landed separately ahead of this epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every shipped doc statement about CLI behavior, storage layout, and repository structure matches the current source tree
- [hard] REQ-02: Adopter-facing docs describe the shipped surface only; repo-local dogfood configuration is relocated to dev/ or explicitly signalled as this repository's setup
- [hard] REQ-03: Shipped docs state current behavior only, with no legacy narration
- [hard] REQ-04: A documentation review gate exists, is required on this epic, and passes before the epic completes
- [hard] REQ-05: Every diagram in docs/ is a Mermaid block; ASCII-art diagrams are forbidden in docs
title: Documentation accuracy and audience boundary cleanup
